scope: lab-only, selected critique heuristics; no global agent installer

rules.symptom: Repeated nested borders obscure the group and row hierarchy.
rules.adopt: Remove a boundary only when spacing, heading or alignment still communicates the same relationship.
rules.countercase: A separately selectable workspace or permission scope needs a visible boundary.
rules.verify: Same heading and row relationship at three widths; confirm real fieldset/legend for choice groups.

rules.symptom: Decorative icon tiles compete with titles but encode no additional information.
rules.adopt: Remove redundant decoration; retain icons that identify an action, person or chosen scope.
rules.source: Unslop UI: icon tile critique; Anti-slop: purpose gate
rules.countercase: An explicitly labeled owner marker helps identify the person; do not apply a universal icon-container ban.
rules.verify: Title, owner and action remain available in text; compare same information lookup.

rules.symptom: A dot or color alone carries the workflow state.
rules.adopt: Name the state in visible text and make the next action explicit.
rules.source: Anti-slop: accessible semantics, state and interaction affordances
rules.countercase: A supplementary dot can remain beside an explicit state label.
rules.verify: State and action readable without hue; completed/ready distinct; status filter keeps accurate count.

rules.symptom: A clickable generic element does not implement Enter/Space behavior.
rules.adopt: Use a native button, dialog focus and a visible focus ring with shared shape.
rules.countercase: Do not add role=button to a static group or use only screenshots as proof of keyboard behavior.
rules.verify: Tab to the action, Enter opens dialog, Escape closes, focus returns to the initiating action.

excluded: Mandatory four-block report for each small edit
Fixed ENERGY/RHYTHM/MOTION dials or forced liveliness
Global sans-serif, serif, emoji or icon-container bans
Forced motion, themes, density or asset purchases
evidence_policy: Fixture task verification is not user research, preference acceptance or application in a frozen product.

local_findings.origin: actual lab sequential task; not a source-author claim
local_findings.observed: Choosing Personal then searching rebuilt the radios with Team checked.
local_findings.repair: Keep selected scope outside render and reuse it on presentation rebuild.
local_findings.scope: Views that rebuild a selectable control while an independent filter changes.
local_findings.verify: Space-select scope, type filter, inspect checked state and matching record; do not infer user preference.

local_findings.origin: actual inspected native focus frame after functional pass
local_findings.observed: A circular native radio kept a rectangular outline despite its CSS border-radius.
local_findings.repair: Preserve native semantics, replace only that outline with a rounded focus shadow.
local_findings.scope: Tested Chromium radio appearance in this fixture, not all browser engines.
local_findings.verify: Keyboard focus + computed treatment + direct frame inspection; style declaration alone is insufficient.
